description: Local-first Codex guidance, project audits, and evidence contracts.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first Codex evidence and project audits.
interface.longDescription: GroundLine is a compact, local-first operating layer for Codex. Seven focused skills coordinate task boundaries, live proof, redacted evidence, current model guidance, personal workflow trials, and App-first surface alignment. The optional Rust CLI validates bounded local evidence and can evaluate or restore an authorized private guidance trial. This Core plugin installs independently and never installs or activates GroundLine Insights. It installs no lifecycle hooks, performs no network requests, creates no background process, and stores no collector identity. Codex continues to own execution, worktrees, review, permissions, agents, compaction, settings, and upgrades.
defaultPrompt: Use $groundline:align-agent-home to apply GroundLine and repair evidenced mistakes in existing Codex settings and guidance with backups and focused verification.
Use $groundline:close-live-work to close source, package, installed App runtime, and live evidence.
Use $groundline:audit-agent-history to simulate efficiency from Codex counters and redacted Chronicle signals.
